name: Coherent Icon Pack
description: Produce a coherent set of UI icons that look like they belong to one family — consistent grid, stroke weight, corner radius, optical sizing, and metaphor language — from a named list of concepts. Lock the style system (grid, stroke, padding, keyline shapes) BEFORE drawing any icon, because icon-set quality is almost entirely about consistency: a pack of individually-nice icons with mismatched strokes looks broken. Then generate every icon to the system and assemble a previewable sheet. Covers icon sets, UI icons, SVG icon libraries, glyph packs, and design systems.
